def parse_grid(data, start_index):
    return [list(data[start_index]), list(data[start_index + 1])]

    return ''.join(grid[0] + grid[1])

    for i in range(2):

    if x < 1: neighbors.append((x + 1, y)) # down

    if y < 1: neighbors.append((x, y + 1)) # right

                visited.add(serialized)
